title: HB2545 (2026 Regular Session): Modifies provisions relating to unlawful possession of a firearm

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk dataset (gun-policy Stage 5 LegiScan check); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official house.mo.gov or senate.mo.gov PDF of the version named in note (via LegiScan getBillText)

operative_text:
Section 571.070 (RSMo): A person commits the offense of unlawful possession of a firearm if such person knowingly has any firearm in his or her possession and: (2) Such person is a fugitive from justice, is habitually in an intoxicated or drugged condition, or is currently adjudged mentally incompetent; or (3) Such person, being an alien: (a) Is illegally or unlawfully in the United States; or (b) Has been admitted to the United States under a nonimmigrant visa, as defined in 8 U.S.C. Section 1101(a)(26), and does not qualify for an exception to the federal prohibition on possession for such aliens under 18 U.S.C. Section 922(y)(2).
Section 571.070 (RSMo): Unlawful possession of a firearm is a class C felony, unless a person has been convicted of a dangerous felony as defined in section 556.061, or the person has a prior conviction for unlawful possession of a firearm in which case it is a class B felony.
